title: A covering presieve of locally matching fpqc representatives
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\{g_i:T_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], and $F$ a sheaf of sets on the small étale site of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets, def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $s_i\in (g_i^{-1}F)(T_i)$ be sections whose two pullbacks on $T_i\times_S T_j$ agree using the unit-compatible composition comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units, def-pc-fibre-product]. There exists a presieve $P$ on the identity étale object $S$ whose generated sieve covers $S$, such that each arrow $f:V\to S$ in $P$ admits a section $t\in F(V)$ with $\eta_{g_i,V}(t)$ equal to the restriction of $s_i$ along $V\times_S T_i\to T_i$ for every $i$. Here $\eta_{g_i,V}:F(V)\to(g_i^{-1}F)(V\times_S T_i)$ is the inverse-image adjunction unit. No representatives are chosen in this assertion, and compatibility between different representatives is not asserted.

proof.text: For each point x of S, joint surjectivity of the fpqc cover supplies a point y of some T_i over x. The inverse-image section description gives a covering by Z_j and representatives t on etale V/S. Joint surjectivity of this etale covering supplies a point z of some Z_j over y.

Apply the single-representative open theorem to this V,t,Z_j and its representing map. Obtain U in V, a point w in U over z, and the restricted section t|_U that matches every s_i. The fibre-product projection equation and the over-category equations give U -> S sending w to x.

Choose these U_x and sections for the points x of S. Their arrows to S form a jointly surjective etale covering because w_x maps to x. Take P to be their presieve of arrows. Each membership witness identifies an arrow with one U_x and gives the asserted section. If S is empty this is the empty covering.
